content: FastAPI fire-and-forget subprocess pattern: call subprocess.Popen() directly inside an async endpoint (without await or blocking). Popen returns immediately — endpoint returns job_id while subprocess runs. On Windows use creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP (start_new_session is POSIX only). Stdout/stderr to subprocess.DEVNULL. Python maintains a list of undisposed Popen objects and calls _cleanup() on new Popen creation to reap zombies. Alternatively wrap Popen call in asyncio.to_thread() to avoid any event loop interaction. D-01 explicitly chose subprocess.Popen not asyncio.create_subprocess_exec to avoid asyncio nesting conflicts.
